| Automated test cases | `apps/beds/tests/test_locations_and_beds.py::test_facility_tree_has_counts`, `apps/beds/tests/test_locations_and_beds.py::test_bed_manager_changes_status_only_in_own_facility`, `apps/beds/tests/test_locations_and_beds.py::test_basic_staff_can_view_but_not_change`, `apps/beds/tests/test_locations_and_beds.py::test_tree_carries_versions_for_editing_in_the_app`, `apps/features/tests/test_features.py::test_locations_can_be_closed_for_one_facility` |
| Backward-compatibility policy | API v1 rules in [the API contracts guide](../README.md#versioning-and-breaking-changes); CI fails when `docs/api/openapi.yaml` differs from the code |
